name: Sankt Peter-Ording (Germany)
description: Blue field bordered above and below by a very narrow white and a somewhat broader red stripe, charged towards the hoist with the yellow crossed keys beneath a star and crescent of the municipal arms of Sankt Peter-Ording.
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 11 July 1967; the flag shows in the hoist of a blue field, bordered above and below by a very narrow white and a somewhat broader red stripe, the figures of the arms.

features.role: star and crescent above the keys
